programme.title: Nature sauvage : Inde: Devenir Gibbon
programme.desc: Retrouvez les houlocks qui préparent leurs petits à la vie dans la nature.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Propriété privées
programme.desc: Tous les animaux ont leur propre territoire. Pouquoi ? Découvrons-le en suivant quelques oiseaux qui vivent le long des cours d'eau de notre péninsule. Et puis plongeons dans l'eau peu profonde pour écouter le chant du... poisson !

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Foudre, histoire d'un vautour prisonnier
programme.desc: Pour les oiseaux, et les rapaces en particulier, la vie n'est pas toujours facile. Qu'ils survolent les villes ou choisissent la campagne comme terrain de chasse, les dangers sont toujours là.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Du côté des insectes
programme.desc: Ce sont de petits êtres vivants, aux formes et aux couleurs surprenantes. Nous les craignons souvent, pourtant certains de ces animaux se sont avérés être nos précieux alliés. De quoi parle-t-on ? Du monde extraordinaire des insectes. Le voilà.

programme.title: 1 000 jours pour la planète: Les victimes de l'huile de palme
programme.desc: La déforestation à grande échelle des forêts tropicales pour la production d'huile de palme est un problème croissant qui menace la survie d'un très grand nombre d'animaux et de plantes, dont beaucoup sont déjà au bord de l'extinction.

programme.title: 1 000 jours pour la planète: La chasse aux cachalots
programme.desc: Le village de Lamalera, en Indonésie, est l'un des derniers endroits au monde où la chasse à la baleine est autorisée ; l'équipage du Sedna IV s'intéresse à cette chasse controversée.

programme.title: Horizons sauvages d'Afrique: La grande oasis d'Afrique - L'Okavango
programme.desc: Découvrez un superbe delta luxuriant et fertile dans le désert de Kalahari.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Et Vogue Le Marsupilami
programme.desc: La famille MARSUPILAMI pique-nique sur les rives du Soupopoaro lorsque BIBU s'éloigne, à la poursuite d'un joli papillon. Il tombe bientôt nez à nez avec une famille de touristes qui l'embarquent pour une croisière sur le Soupopoaro.

programme.title: Marsupilami: L'ami Marsupilami
programme.desc: Valentine, fille du magnat du jouet PABLO REGALO, est décidément très capricieuse : elle VEUT un MARSUPILAMI. Lorsque Odile, sa nounou, part le capturer en pleine jungle de Palombie, elle ne sait pas encore à quelle agitation elle s’expose.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Le Marsupilami À New York I
programme.desc: Endormi dans une caisse à destination de New York, le MARSUPILAMI se réveille aux douanes de l’aéroport JFK. Au même moment, BRING, bien décidé à passer des vacances loin de la Palombie arrive lui aussi à New York.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Le Marsupilami À New York Ii
programme.desc: Après avoir semé une formidable pagaille et dévoré l’ensemble des piranhas du jardin botanique, le MARSUPILAMI s’échappe. Son visage est désormais sur tous les écrans de T.V : un avis de recherche a été lancé.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Élève Marsupilami
programme.desc: A la vue du MARSUPILAMI, deux élèves du collège de Chiquito n’ont qu’une envie : le ramener en ville pour en faire la mascotte de l’école.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Rien Ne Va Plus Chez Les Marsupilamis
programme.desc: SAM LARNAC a trouvé le moyen de gagner de l’argent facilement : il organise des safaris “ MARSUPILAMIS ”. En réalité, l’animal que photographient les touristes n’est qu’un vulgaire costume, porté par sa comparse FELICIA.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Le Marsupilami Dans La Pampa
programme.desc: BLOUNZ le contrebandier endort toute la famille des MARSUPILAMIS grâce à un soporifique puissant. Aux commandes de son avion, il file avec sa précieuse cargaison afin de la revendre en ville.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Le Marsu Pile L'ennemi
programme.desc: Le vieil entraîneur Pépé le Coco est désespéré : ses catcheurs sont systématiquement battus par ses adversaires. Encore un match perdu, et il doit fermer boutique.

programme.title: Marsupilami: Le Marsupilami À La Une
programme.desc: BRING a décidé de mettre un terme à ses années d'échecs répétés dans la traque du MARSUPILAMI. Pour ce faire, il a monté une expédition composée d'experts en traque, camouflage, etc...

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: La sorcière de Salem
programme.desc: Salem tombe amoureux d'une beauté féline.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le palais de Topkapi à Istanbul
programme.desc: Le palais de Topkapi à Istanbul

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Musée d'Israël à Jérusalem
programme.desc: Visité par un million de personnes chaque année, le Musée d'Israël abrite la plus grande collection au monde de vestiges liés la Bible et à la Terre sainte.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Palacio Real de Madrid
programme.desc: A la fois musée et palais officiel de la famille régnante, le Palacio Real de Madrid abrite des objets et des oeuvres ayant appartenu aux rois et reines d'Espagne.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Musée historique d'Etat de Moscou
programme.desc: Le Musée historique d'Etat de Moscou présente l'histoire de la Russie et de son peuple sur une période s'étendant de l'âge de pierre à la chute du Mur de Berlin.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: La Smithsonian Institution à Washington
programme.desc: Fondée en 1846 par le scientifique James Smithson, la Smithonian Institution est le plus grand musée et le plus grand centre de recherche scientifique au monde.

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: La Provence, c’est une lumière particulière, un patrimoine naturel et architectural dont la beauté a inspiré les plus grands peintres. C’est un monde de saveurs, de couleurs et d’odeurs.

programme.title: Chacun son Île
programme.desc: Située dans le fleuve Brahmapoutre dans l’État de l’Assam du nord-est de l’Inde, l’île isolée de Majuli a récemment reçu le titre de la plus grande île fluviale au monde.

programme.title: Chacun son Île
programme.desc: Îles Malouines, Malvinas ou Falkland? Voilà un débat qui perdure dans ce Territoire d’outre-mer du Royaume-Uni!

programme.title: Des villes à hauteur d’hommes: Episode 2: Copenhague
programme.desc: Mikael découvre sa propre ville de Copenhague et rencontre ses habitants qui travaillent à en faire une des villes les plus agréables à vivre.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: L’Inde : New Delhi - Varanasi
programme.desc: L’Inde est fascinante, à tel point que Milan et Muammer prennent le temps de jouer les touristes dans les ruelles de New-Delhi et devant le Taj Mahal à Agra.

programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 jours sans un sou: La Thaïlande : Varanasi - Chumphon
programme.desc: Après un petit bain dans le Gange « pour se purifier », les « Optimistics Traveler » atteignent Calcutta, à l’Est de l’Inde. Leur nouvel objectif : se faire payer deux billets d’avion pour la Thaïlande.

programme.title: Y'a que la vérité qui compte: Episode 31
programme.desc: Le principe est simple : une personne en invite une autre afin de lui faire une déclaration devant la France entière. L'invité découvre sur le plateau qui l'a fait venir, et peut décider de lever le rideau qui les sépare et le rejoindre... ou pas !

programme.desc: Après sa victoire au championnat de France, Nanou parvient à battre le record d'Europe. Cependant, avec la gloire viennent les désagréments, entre sollicitations de toutes sortes et intrusions dans la vie privée de sa famille.

programme.title: François Gaillard ou la vie des autres
programme.desc: Cécile et Nicolas, comédiens dans la même troupe, souhaitent divorcer par consentement mutuel non reconnu par la loi. Le couple doit donc se chercher des torts réciproques. François, avocat de Nicolas, se retrouve face à Annie qui défend Cécile.

programme.title: Messieurs les jurés
programme.desc: Monsieur Médard, entrepreneur, voit sa fille plonger dans le coma suite à un accident de moto. Face à des jeunes motards, la tension monte, le drame éclate. Procès bouleversant sur conflit de générations.

programme.title: À bout portant
programme.desc: Comédien et chanteur emblématique des sixties, Philippe Clay a enchaîné les succès populaires et prêté sa voix aux textes des plus grands. Il évoque ici le pire et le meilleur de son existence et esquisse un autoportrait éclatant d'optimisme.

programme.title: Des chiffres et des lettres
programme.desc: Présenté par Patrice Laffont. Deux candidats s'affrontent pour le mot le plus long et le compte est bon, leurs compétences en calcul mental et en orthographe sont mises à rude épreuve !

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Hurlement du Loup Garou
programme.desc: Pendant que Martin est au Centre en train de nettoyer l'Entrepôt de Confinement pour Créature (une "mission" que M.O.M. lui a confié), il est griffé par une féroce créature loup-garou.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Revanche des Nains de Jardin
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Fureur du Ver en Terre
programme.desc: Dans un teaser, on découvre martin pourchassant une terrifiante créature à l'aspect de verre de terre alors qu'elle se creuse un chemin à travers le campus. Il arrive finalement à l'attraper et la met dans une unité de confinement.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Jour des Ombres - 1ère Partie
programme.desc: Martin se réveille un matin, épuisé, après une longue nuit de bricolage surnaturel sous les puissantes lampes de sa chambre laboratoire du dortoir. A son grand étonnement, il découvre que personne d'autre que lui n'est dans les parages.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Jour des Ombres - 2ème Partie
programme.desc: Avec Caitlin, MOM, Diana et Java piégés dans la dimension de l'ombre, c'est à Martin et Billy de les sauver, eux... et le monde.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Nuit de l'Epouvantail
programme.desc: Lorsque Tante Tamsen, la tante (préférée) de Martin, achète une ferme pas trop loin de Torrington, Martin, Diana et Java arrivent en voiture pour le week-end afin de l'aider à cultiver et faire fonctionner la ferme. Au début, tout se passe bien...

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Les Prisonniers du Placard
programme.desc: M.O.M. envoie Martin, Diana et Java enquêter dans une université où une populaire joueuse de foot a mystérieusement disparue.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Réveil du Sorcier
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: L'Attaque de la Plante Carnivore
programme.desc: Martin, Diana et Java sont envoyés dans une ville voisine pour examiner les disparitions de plusieurs adolescents.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Malédiction du Pirate
programme.desc: Pendant que Martin et l'équipe sont en visite scolaire au Musée de la Marine, Martin s'éclipse du groupe (avec Java à sa suite). Il a hâte d'examiner les objets venant d'un vaisseau légendaire qui fût autrefois commandé par un pirate fantôme en maraude.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Retour du Génie
programme.desc: Lorsque Diana, qui se sent seule parce qu'elle n'a pas eu de rendez-vous avec un garçon depuis longtemps, commence à recevoir des messages d'un admirateur secret, elle est excitée que quelqu'un l'ait en fait remarqué.

programme.title: Les Z'amours
programme.desc: Jeu iconique dans lequel des couples répondent à des questions pour découvrir s’ils se connaissent vraiment bien ! Dans chaque épisode, trois couples s’affrontent en 2 manches. Le couple ayant obtenu le score le plus élevé est le gagnant.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Alors que la pression monte pour capturer un poisson, les capitaines forment des alliances pour augmenter leurs chances de réaliser de nouvelles prises.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Un orage s'abat sur Gloucester, et les capitaines doivent lutter contre les éléments s'ils veulent capturer un thon rouge.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Alors que la saison arrive à un tournant, une modification des quotas oblige les bateaux à repousser leurs limites, ce qui crée des tensions au sein de la flotte.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Le quota étant passé à un thon rouge par jour, la pression est croissante, car les capitaines doivent rapporter du poisson chaque jour pour rester compétitifs.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Le capitaine Tyler McLaughlin, sous pression, cherche à dominer le classement. Il retrouve le moral lorsqu'un nouveau bateau dont l'équipage lui est familier se joint à la flotte.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Au cours de la douzième semaine de pêche, les capitaines prennent la décision de chasser le thon rouge à plus de 400 km de leur base de Gloucester.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Dans le sud de la France, les Pyrénées-Orientales sont un morceau de Catalogne perdu entre mer et montagne. Sur la côte rocheuse, la chaîne des Pyrénées plonge dans la Méditerranée.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Ce circuit nous conduit à la découverte des lieux enchanteurs du sud-est de l'hexagone : Gourdon, Grasse, Biot, la chapelle du Rosaire de Vence, Saint-Paul-de-Vence, Saorge, le fort de Sainte-Agnès, la Vallée des Merveilles.

programme.title: Les 100 lieux qu'il faut voir
programme.desc: Emblème de la chaîne des Puys, ces volcans endormis depuis plus de 11 000 ans, le Puy-de-Dôme est l'un des spots français les plus réputés pour le parapente. Cependant, le Puy-de-Dôme, ce sont également des ruines gallo-romaines.

programme.title: Les villages de nos régions
programme.desc: De la belle et sauvage Côte d'Opale à la Côte d'Albâtre, jusqu'aux authentiques villages picards, les Hauts-de-France possèdent des paysages indomptables et des traditions fortes. Notre balade débute à Wissant, un ancien village de pêcheurs.

programme.title: Les villages de nos régions
programme.desc: Région au patrimoine riche, la Normandie possède aussi une palette de somptueux paysages, des décors vertigineux de bords de mer aux cités plus cossues.

programme.title: Les villages de nos régions
programme.desc: Dans cette région du Sud-Ouest, les paysages comme les traditions sont nombreux et divers. Notre itinéraire démarrera dans le Marais Poitevin avec la découverte d'Arçais, un village bordé de canaux, et s'achèvera près de la frontière espagnole.

programme.title: Shimmer et Shine
programme.desc: Zac a construit une cabane dans un arbre dont il est très fier, mais qui est très sommaire et malheureusement pas très sécurisée. Profitant de l'occasion, Léa appelle ses génies à la rescousse.

programme.title: Shimmer et Shine
programme.desc: Léa fait appel à ses amies pour qu'elles l'aident à se préparer pour la fête de son quartier. Suite à un quiproquo, les génies font appraître deux petits cochons très mignons, mais très coquins.

programme.title: Shimmer et Shine
programme.desc: Zac et Léa profitent de la plage. Pendant que Zac tente de récupérer un coquillage auprès du crabe, Léa part à l'aventure avec les deux génies sur un bateau de pirate.

programme.title: Shimmer et Shine
programme.desc: Léa et Zac ont prévu une soirée film, mais le pop-corn brûle et le film se fonctionne pas. Ils demandent à Shimmer et Shine un coup de pouce magique, mais se retrouvent dans le film !

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: La cordonnière a envoyé à Babouche les mauvaises chaussures. Au lieu de ses bottes adorées, le voilà chaussé de bottes rebondissantes. Pars avec Dora et lui pour une aventure pleine de rebondissements!

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: C'est le jour du tournoi de Pok Ta Pok au Royaume Maya. Fais équipe avec Dora, Babouche et les frères jumeaux et remporte le match de jeu de balle!

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Alicia emmène des pingouins meurtris au centre de sauvetage mais son bateau se retrouve coincé dans la glace. Diego et le bébé jaguar viennent prêter main forte à Alicia pour sauver les pingouins.

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Tous les éléphants d’Afrique ont été transformés en rochers par un méchant magicien. Diego, bébé jaguar et Alicia doivent rompre le sort !

programme.title: Blaze et les Monster Machines
programme.desc: Afin de remporter la grande course, Crusher met A.J. et Gabby dans une bulle et les éloigne de Blaze et Watts. Ces derniers vont alors tout faire pour délivrer leurs pilotes avant le départ.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: L'intraitable inspecteur Coup d'œil vient faire passer le Grand Examen aux élèves officiers de la Team Top Wing.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: La Team Top Wing recherche le piano que Rocco et Chomps ont dérobé, pour que Rod puisse chanter au récital de Tourbillonîle. // Les singes convoitent des bananes destinées à Rhonda.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: Le doudou de Rod a disparu. La Team Top Wing doit le retrouver pour que tout le monde puisse dormir. // Earl construit une planche de surf turbo incontrôlable. La team Top Wing doit intervenir !

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'arène du carnage
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Bataille pour la Dimension X
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: iCarly: Le bêtisier d'iCarly
programme.desc: Miranda, l'actrice qui joue le rôle d'iCarly convoque Jerry, le comédien jouant Spencer sur le plateau pour lui remonter les bretelles.

programme.title: iCarly: L'anniversaire de Carly
programme.desc: C'est l'anniversaire de Carly, Spencer veut lui faire un cadeau original. Il fabrique une lampe avec des bonbons qui prend feu. La chambre de Carly brûle entièrement. Grâce à l'argent de l'assurance,

programme.title: iCarly: Je le veux
programme.desc: Carly reçoit une demande originale : Gordon, un fan de l'émission, veut demander la main de sa petite amie, Jodi, en direct. Jodi accepte la demande en mariage et convie Carly et ses amis au mariage!

programme.title: iCarly: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.title: iCarly: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: iCarly: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Le stagiaire
programme.desc: L'émission a de plus en plus de succès et le groupe a donc de plus en plus de travail. Ils décident d'engager un stagiaire pour les aider.

programme.title: iCarly: lance la guerre des fans - Partie 1
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: iCarly: lance la guerre des fans - Partie 2
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: iCarly: Révélation
programme.desc: Brad devient le nouveau stagiaire de l'émission. Freddie et lui créent une application pour Pear Pad : le testeur d'humeur. Freddie l'utilise sur Sam et découvre qu'elle est amoureuse.

programme.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (1968)
programme.desc: A weird inventor, Caractacus Potts, invents an amazing flying car, which drives by itself. It takes him and his Family to Vulgaria, where the sinister buffoon Baron Bomburst kidnaps the car.

programme.title: The Caddy
programme.desc: In this zany farce, Harvey is a shy but talented pro golfer who, because he can't face the crowds, coaxes his buddy Joe into a big-time tournament. As Joe's caddy, Harvey is a disaster, and the two have a hilarious quarrel.

programme.title: The Patsy
programme.desc: When a popular entertainer meets with an untimely death, his shocked showbiz associates scramble desperately to find a quick replacement.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Big Happy Family
programme.desc: When Shirley receives distressing news about her health, it’s up to her Aunt Madea to gather the clan and make things right the only way she knows how: with tough love and laughter.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: The Aggressor
programme.desc: David Sloan is on a mission to free his wife who has been enslaved by an evil world champion, Tong Po. He attempts to gain entry into Po’s savage kingdom by fighting in the tournament of champions where the winner takes all.

programme.title: The Redemption: Kickboxer 5
programme.desc: A retired kickboxer goes on a mission to avenge the brutal death of his promising young student. Revenge is not easy, however, as the target of his wrath is a leader of an underworld kickboxing league.

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a married workaholic is given a universal remote that lets him pause, rewind, or skip past parts of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Child 44
programme.desc: Exiled secret police officer Leo Demidov (Tom Hardy) discovers a serial killer and suspects his superiors of covering it up. It is up to Leo to stop the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling book series comes a fantasy adventure that reveals the unseen world all around us.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle, where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: When Jack Deebs was behind bars he found escape by creating Cool World, a cartoon series featuring a vixen named Holli Would. The flesh proves weaker than ink, however, as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: 20 years ago, a tragic accident on Valentine's Day took the lives of 5 miners when supervisors left their posts to attend a Valentine's Day dance. On the disaster's first anniversary, the only survivor returns to the town for bloody revenge

programme.title: Messiah Of Evil
programme.desc: A woman arrives in a seaside town after receiving unsettling letters from her father, only to discover it's under the influence of a strange cult.

programme.title: Dead & Buried
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in the quiet coastal village of Potters Bluff, where tourists and transients are warmly welcomed... then brutally murdered. But even more shocking is when these slain strangers reappear as normal citizens around town.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Chato, a half-Apache horseman, is on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer, who is determined to see him dead. Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed, thanks to the unforgiving, cruel desert.

programme.title: Rio Lobo
programme.desc: This fifth and final collaboration between John Wayne and director Howard Hawks is an action-filled Western set after the Civil War, in which a group of men seek out Union traitors responsible for a string of train robbers.

programme.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
programme.desc: The fourth film in the dark superhero franchise is an epic new action tale. After an ex-con tries to straighten out his life, he and his girlfriend are brutally murdered by a renegade gang. A mysterious crow brings him back for revenge and redemption.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Shin Ultraman
programme.desc: A silver giant descends from the sky to rescue the planet. Dubbed Ultraman, this giant's identity and purpose are a mystery.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Chris "Slapshot" Pratt, whose once-bright future has been dimmed by a severe head injury, is a night janitor at a bank. Lonely and frustrated, he falls prey to a con man and agrees to help rob the bank where he works.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: The Protégé
programme.desc: Rescued as a child by the legendary assassin Moody, Anna is the world's most skilled contract killer. However, when Moody is brutally killed, she vows revenge for the man who taught her everything she knows.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. When the gang leader re-emerges, Bell embarks on an obsessive quest to bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: From acclaimed Director Alejandro Gonz

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Charlie is out of jail and on the make with a plan for the heist of the century. Aided by top criminal mastermind Mr Bridger, Charlie sets off with a team of villains and to lift $4,000,000 from under the noses of the Turin Polizei.

programme.title: Alfie
programme.desc: Alfie is not really a bad sort. It’s just that he has this overwhelming desire for the opposite sex. You might say that “birds’ are irresistible to him, sort of second nature.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Brain
programme.desc: A billionaire, intent on destroying Communism by starting a world war, is close to achieving his goal with the help of the world's largest, and most powerful, computer. Secret Agent Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is the only man who can stop him!

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Secret Service agent Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack and works to rescue the President from his kidnappers.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Menace II Society
programme.desc: In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular American Ninja franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: The American Ninja burst onto the screen in a fourth round of martial arts Action.

programme.title: Enter the Ninja
programme.desc: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura, Pet Detective, is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback, Dan Marino. He goes eye-to-eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins, and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Uptown Girls
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever made was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Kris is forced to help her neighbor, an ex-bull rider scraping by on the Texas rodeo circuit.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Alfie
programme.desc: Alfie is not really a bad sort. It’s just that he has this overwhelming desire for the opposite sex. You might say that “birds’ are irresistible to him, sort of second nature.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Brain
programme.desc: A billionaire, intent on destroying Communism by starting a world war, is close to achieving his goal with the help of the world's largest, and most powerful, computer. Secret Agent Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is the only man who can stop him!

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Secret Service agent Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack and works to rescue the President from his kidnappers.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Menace II Society
programme.desc: In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Enter the Ninja
programme.desc: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

programme.title: Revenge of the Ninja
programme.desc: Sho Kosugi ("Enter the Ninja") delivers a heart-pounding display of strength, speed and lethal Ninja know-how in this action-packed thriller that takes us back to the good old days of the Kung Fu extravaganza.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a married workaholic is given a universal remote that lets him pause, rewind, or skip past parts of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best.

programme.title: 30 Nights of Paranormal Activity...
programme.desc: After a stint in a psychiatric hospital, a young woman returns to the house where her father killed the entire cast of The Artist during his exorcism.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Uptown Girls
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Requiem for a Dream
programme.desc: Darren Aronofsky directs Oscar winners Jared Leto, Jennifer Connelly, and Ellen Burstyn in this hypnotic tale about addiction.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Kris is forced to help her neighbor, an ex-bull rider scraping by on the Texas rodeo circuit.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Due to her father's rule, a popular high school student isn't allowed to date boys until she can successfully locate a willing suitor for her ill-tempered older sister to agree to go out with, but her sister wants nothing to do with boys.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Hellraiser
programme.desc: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

programme.title: Vacancy
programme.desc: A suspenseful, classic thriller, in the tradition of Alfred Hitchcock, starring Luke Wilson and Kate Beckinsale, that will keep you on the edge of your seat and your heart pounding! Rated: R

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Trapped by a snowstorm with her estranged grandmother's corpse, Rosario (Emeraude Toubia) faces terrifying supernatural forces and a deadly family curse.

programme.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
programme.desc: A coven of vampires hunts on dating apps, meeting vampire hunters and scheduling dates. The nights that unfold are action-packed, modern-horror madness.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: The heat is on in this fast-paced action-comedy starring Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley, a street smart Detroit cop tracking down his best friend's killer in Beverly Hills.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Crocodile Dundee returns in this hilarious third installment of the beloved film series. After Mick's girlfriend, Sue, is assigned to the L.A. bureau of her father's newspaper, Mick, Sue, and their son Mikey head to Hollywood.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Horns
programme.desc: A man wakes up after the death of his girlfriend to find he has grown horns.

programme.title: Imperium
programme.desc: Inspired by real events. To stop domestic terrorists from building a dirty bomb, an FBI agent (Daniel Radcliffe) poses as an extremist, infiltrating a dissident group to find its dangerous leaders.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the town is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: Comedy sensation Mike Myers stars with Nancy Travis in this hatchet-driven romantic comedy about a wedlock-shy coffee house poet who finally meets the perfect woman. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Three Days of the Condor
programme.desc: A mild-mannered CIA researcher, paid to read books, returns from lunch to find all of his co-workers assassinated. "Condor" must find out who did this and get in from the cold before the hitmen get him.

programme.title: Rolling Thunder
programme.desc: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threaten to kill the hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Team America, an international police force dedicated to maintaining global stability learns that a power hungry dictator is brokering weapons of mass destruction to terrorists.

programme.title: Disaster Movie

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.desc: Un'amica di Paula partorisce in ospedale, ma in seguito muore perchè non viene correttamente assistita. La polizia indaga senza risultati. Paula continua ad indagare di nascosto e grazie ad una testimonianza riuscirà a scoprire la verità.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Linda ha una relazione con un uomo sposato. L'amante, invece di lasciare la moglie, decide di uccidere Linda e fa accusare il giardiniere del palazzo. Un testimone informa la polizia attraverso la posta elettronica per non rivelare la sua identità.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Lionel Perret, arrestato per abusi su minori, viene scarcerato per un errore procedurale. Il giorno dopo viene trovato a casa, incosciente e brutalmente picchiato.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Lucien Mauville, 70 anni, viene trovato morto nel seminterrato di casa, legato e torturato. Un pensionato senza precedenti penali, apparentemente senza nemici né beni di valore.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Il corpo di una giovane giurata viene trovato vicino al tribunale. Boris e Constance scoprono che la vittima aveva denunciato pressioni indebite del presidente della Corte sulle deliberazioni della giuria.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Il corpo di una donna di 35 anni viene trovato dietro un cassonetto vicino alla stazione Saint‑Charles. Constance e Boris scoprono che viveva a Marsiglia da anni sotto falsa identità.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Nel vano di una barca a vela viene trovato morto un uomo di 50 anni. Constance è sconvolta: la vittima era un amico d’infanzia di suo marito Barth.
